//: A branch behind the default branch takes it in by a merge, keeping both sides of the conflict, and pushes nothing.
title: Both new functions survive the merge, the tests pass, and nothing is pushed

argv: git merge-base --is-ancestor main HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" = feature/shout && test -n "$(git log --merges -1 --format=%H)"
grep -q "def shout" greet.py && grep -q "def farewell" greet.py
